_about: How a computer's fighter defence meets a raid (the tactics panel's air brief, item 5; the design director's ruling 239 and its rider of 20:58Z). A style is a temperament, not a weapon: it moves where the defence's weight falls, never how much (217, b418). escort: the share of the defence's weight dealt to the raid's escort, in whole groups. climb: bands above the raid's highest box the staff climbs to when radar warns it in time; drawn, never priced. A split defence fights from one pool (ruling 239, 21:10Z): a group's role says only where it flies. A human defender has no style. Read by src/battle/air/styles.ts.
_cap: ahead: metres toward the raid a fleet's own fighter cover starts (the Pearl Harbor and Midway thread's S1).
_pick: Stops 4 and 5, from the ticket's facts, never the nation: raw (experience under 'raw' and no early warning) flies mass; an escort weighing at least 'escort' x the defence flies bold; otherwise methodical. 'free': the escortRoles hook, an escort weighing at least 'free' x the defence sweeps first.
_lean: Stops 1 to 3: the air column of the one lean table (ruling 239.1 as amended 20:58Z; the land branch lays the table, and this copy must equal its air column). _default: methodical, but mass while raw.
_path: Growth at stops 1 to 3, never by date: the first step at leaders' experience 'first.xp' or holding 'first.tech'; the second at experience 'second.xp' and holding 'second.tech'.
